sentences.en: She has a strong wish to work as an interpreter.
sentences.zh: 1. 她非常希望成为一名口译员工作。

sentences.en: Why don't you apply for the job of interpreter?
sentences.zh: 2. 为什么不申请这份口译员的工作呢？

sentences.en: She is working as a volunteer interpreter at the international conference.
sentences.zh: 3. 她正在国际会议上担任志愿者口译员。

senses.zh: 口译工作者;口译译员 - 演绎(音乐、戏剧中人物等)的人 - 解释程序
